action.objective: Play Bd4, keeping the bishop active and pinning the d6-pawn's defender while avoiding the bishop trade.
action.rationale: b6d4 is the only commit_ready move: verified at depth 3 with exact score +31, complete safety probe (no mate, no tactical refutation), and broad search favored it. Bd4 retains the strong bishop and pressures f6/d6, better than the c3e4 line (score +8) which trades into an inferior structure. No verified alternative exists and no refutation was found.
